description: Paths whose change needs an ADR (blueprint §13): trust boundaries, persisted formats, public contracts, the process model, the framework, the license and signing. CI requires a new or changed file under docs/adr/ in any pull request that touches one of these globs ('*' within a path segment, '**' across segments).
